_purpose: Params of tools/art/env_kit (run_env_kit.py -> env_kit_build.py / orientation_check.py) for the 7 usable Tripo ENV props of run 20261001-tripo-h31-p5 (ENV-MAPS P5, concept-review gaps 2, 4, 6, 7, 14). ENV-M-CHERRY-V2 is NOT processed (ENV-U13: cherries / Sarpedon trees go to free Fab packs later). Target sizes are the P5 task proposal (uu = cm), measured against, not accepted values; scale of the existing kit: cells ~84 uu circles, figures ~40-60 uu tall.
_sizes: Tripo proportions (GLB POSITION extents, x width / y up / z depth): Balustrade 0.980 x 0.301 x 0.094 -> length 150 gives 46 uu tall (task ~150 x 45); HedgeBed 0.978 x 0.297 x 0.174 -> length 150 gives 45.5 uu tall (task ~150 x 40: a uniform scale cannot meet both, the length is kept so a bed matches a balustrade segment); RockOutcrop 0.978 x 0.850 x 0.745 -> height 70 gives 80.5 uu long (task 60-90 for both); Banner 0.464 x 0.976 -> height 120 gives 57 uu wide; LanternPost 0.583 x 0.977 -> height 95 gives 57 uu (bracket arm); Barrel height 28 -> 21.4 diameter; CrateStack height 45 -> 49 wide.

orientation.note: A yaw other than 0 is applied only when a 90/180/270 deg turn beats the Tripo front by >= apply_min_iou_gain mean silhouette IoU over the four reference views; smaller differences keep the Tripo front (the Tripo H3.1 multiview contract) and are reported

ue.fbx_material_slot: M_Env_<Name> (slot 0; the MI is assigned to it in UE)
ue.import: legacy FBX, import_uniform_scale 1.0, import_materials false, import_textures false, collision none (decor, not interactive), build_nanite false

textures.N: sRGB off, TC_Normalmap, flip_green false (PNG is DirectX already)
